projects.title: Agricultural Disease Diagnosis with GAN-Based Synthetic Data Augmentation
projects.description: A deep learning framework for agricultural disease diagnosis that leverages GAN-based synthetic data augmentation to improve disease classification performance and address class imbalance in plant disease datasets.

projects.title: AI Human Deception Game
projects.description: A browser-based research prototype studying whether people can detect deception from a human or an AI in a safety-critical decision task.

projects.title: AI Reasoning
projects.description: When AI justify a house-price estimation, a critique style harder to detect to fact-check or a direct recommendation, even when both are equally wrong, in reliable and unreliable situation.

projects.title: MindEase - RAG-Based Mental Wellness Support Assistant
projects.description: A Streamlit app that retrieves evidence-informed coping strategies from a curated knowledge base and uses an open-source LLM (via the Hugging Face Inference API) to turn them into a warm, personalized suggestion, not a diagnosis.

projects.title: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning and Deep Learning for Brain Tumor Detection
projects.description: A comparative study evaluating machine learning and deep learning approaches for brain tumor detection and classification from MRI images using feature extraction and convolutional neural networks.

projects.title: Mapping Symptom Propagation Pathways of Anxiety, Stress and Depression Using Network and Causal Discovery Methods across Bangladeshi Private Students
projects.description: A mental health research project that explores symptom interactions and propagation pathways of anxiety, stress, and depression using network analysis and causal discovery techniques.

projects.title: Real-Time Digit Detection
projects.description: A computer vision application for real-time handwritten digit detection and recognition using deep learning and image processing techniques.

projects.title: Women Safety Portal
projects.description: A web-based women safety platform that provides emergency assistance, safety resources and interactive features to support women's security and well-being.

projects.title: AI-Powered Project Management Assistant
projects.description: An AI-driven project management assistant designed to support project planning, effort estimation, work breakdown structures, scheduling and resource allocation.

projects.title: AI Content Detection
projects.description: A machine learning system for detecting AI-generated content and distinguishing it from human-written text using natural language processing techniques.

projects.title: Layers of Sylhet
projects.description: A digital storytelling and cultural heritage project showcasing the history, traditions, and landmarks of Sylhet through an interactive platform.

projects.title: An Affordable Tactile Controller for Vision Impaired Computer Access
projects.description: A human-computer interaction project that proposes an affordable tactile controller to improve computer accessibility for visually impaired users.
